values.note: Book online (Wright County WebTrac) or through the park office, 320-286-2801. Seven same-day sites (39, 40, 47, 50, M, A, B) are reserved only on the day, by calling the office after 8 a.m. 2026: campsite reservations opened March 2. The 7-night limit runs Memorial Day to Labor Day, then 48 hours off the property; outside that window the manager can allow longer stays. Cancelling costs $15 a site 14+ days out, $20 at 7-13 days, $25 within 6 days. Check-out 1 p.m.

note: Wright County regional park on Collinwood Lake southwest of Cokato; the electric loop sits in trees above the beach and day-use area, the full-service loop in the open to the south. Swimming beach, fishing pier, boat access, fish cleaning house. --Claude
